## Expert Lecture on “Powering Tomorrow: Innovation, Intelligence & Impact in the Future Energy Landscape”

News Date : 10 Oct 2025News ReportTheIndustry–Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC)in collaboration with theDepartment of Mechanical Engineering,Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), organized anExpert Lectureon10th October 2025as part of the IIPC activities.Dr. V. S. K. Murthy Balijepalli, CEO,LUCES Innovation Consulting, delivered an insightful talk on“Powering Tomorrow: Innovation, Intelligence & Impact in the Future Energy Landscape.”In his address, Dr. Murthy elaborated on the evolving contours of the power sector — highlighting howArtificial Intelligence (AI),Internet of Things (IoT), andBlockchaintechnologies are transforming energy management, grid resilience, and consumer engagement. He emphasized the significance ofenergy transition, theglobal shift towards net-zero goals, and thechallenges of decentralized energy systems.The lecture witnessed enthusiastic participation from students and faculty members across various departments.Dr. P. Chandra Sekhar, Convenor, IIPC, summarized the session and expressed gratitude to the distinguished speaker for sharing his valuable insights.

TheIndustry–Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC)in collaboration with theDepartment of Mechanical Engineering,Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), organized anExpert Lectureon10th October 2025as part of the IIPC activities.
Dr. V. S. K. Murthy Balijepalli, CEO,LUCES Innovation Consulting, delivered an insightful talk on“Powering Tomorrow: Innovation, Intelligence & Impact in the Future Energy Landscape.”
In his address, Dr. Murthy elaborated on the evolving contours of the power sector — highlighting howArtificial Intelligence (AI),Internet of Things (IoT), andBlockchaintechnologies are transforming energy management, grid resilience, and consumer engagement. He emphasized the significance ofenergy transition, theglobal shift towards net-zero goals, and thechallenges of decentralized energy systems.
The lecture witnessed enthusiastic participation from students and faculty members across various departments.
Dr. P. Chandra Sekhar, Convenor, IIPC, summarized the session and expressed gratitude to the distinguished speaker for sharing his valuable insights.
